void-opening.description: Deep sub-bass drone, dark void, minimal — cold opens, black screen, single ember moments
void-opening.pixabay_query: cinematic sub bass drone dark ambience

ancient-river.pixabay_query: river birds nature ambient peaceful flowing water

ancient-city.pixabay_query: ancient city crowd ambience outdoor market murmur

desert-wind.pixabay_query: desert wind ambient dry sparse outdoor
